description: National Research Council Canada publishes a reference service-life workbook for non-structural building-envelope materials. The named repository page offers a 56 KiB XLSX file under the Open Government Licence Canada 2.0, without charge. Researchers compiled values from North American survey reports and environmental product declarations, grouped by material type and frequency. The geographic coverage is North America. The source reports and declarations span differing publication years; the collection is not a longitudinal field-monitoring series. The values can inform component replacement schedules, life-cycle simulation and uncertainty tests for building-stock models. The article finds major gaps: more than half the reviewed declarations do not report reference service life, and many others use default values of 60 or 75 years without product-specific justification. Older surveys may not reflect current materials. The workbook contents were not downloaded or reconciled against each source declaration. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
